items.name: the necklace of Harmonia
items.description: Vulcan's fatal necklace made for Harmonia, bringing doom to its wearers; Eriphyle takes it from Argia and betrays Amphiaraus.

wikipedia.lead: The Necklace of Harmonia, also called the Necklace of Eriphyle, was a fabled object in Greek mythology that, according to legend, brought great misfortune to all of its wearers or owners, who were primarily queens and princesses of the ill-fated House of Thebes.

items.name: the Argo
items.description: Ship of the Argonauts, which Hypsipyle recalls landing at Lemnos where the women first attack, then welcome it.

wikipedia.lead: In Greek mythology, the Argo was the ship of Jason and the Argonauts. The ship was built with divine aid and carried the Argonauts on their quest for the Golden Fleece from Iolcos to Colchis.

items.name: the thunderbolt
items.description: Jove's weapon, with which he strikes down the defiant Capaneus at the walls of Thebes.

wikipedia.lead: Zeus is the supreme deity of the Greek pantheon. He is a sky and thunder god in ancient Greek religion and mythology, who rules as king of the gods on Mount Olympus.
